subject: Thou Art Ready for Anything
text: A commenter reported the level 30 achievement did not unlock although their hero was lv30.

evidence.quote: [Earthsouls] Hafing issues with this unlocking, my hero is lv30 and didnt get it.

subject: Thou Art a Slayer
text: If the hero is poisoned when reaching the level required for this achievement, the poison must be cleared before the achievement is granted.

evidence.quote: Just a note if you are poisoned when you achieve this level, you need to clear this status first before getting the achievement.
